subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should maintainers require fresh WSL/Testbox reproduction before queueing another narrow repair for the agent-tools workspace-paths and safe-bins tests?
rationale: The source shape still matches the report, but the issue currently carries no-new-fix-pr, needs-maintainer-review, and needs-live-repro labels, so automation should not open another fix PR without human proof direction.

options.title: Require fresh WSL proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and require a WSL/Testbox run or explicit maintainer confirmation before queueing the narrow test-harness repair.

options.title: Allow a source-backed repair now
options.body: Queue a narrow test-only repair using the existing shared temp helpers and WSL guard surface without waiting for live reproduction.

options.title: Keep fs-safe PR separate
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 proceed or close on its own without using it to resolve this issue.

recommendation.title: Require fresh WSL proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and require a WSL/Testbox run or explicit maintainer confirmation before queueing the narrow test-harness repair.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the affected test files and authored the prior review that defined the narrow fix boundary.
